name: robots/asig-x__jeplo
title: JEPLO Unitree Go2 locomotion (Isaac Lab)
intro: JEPLO Unitree Go2 locomotion (Isaac Lab), adapted from asig-x/jeplo. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/asig-x__jeplo --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/asig-x__jeplo --backend fake --mcp
